title: CLASH: EVALUATING LANGUAGE MODELS ON JUDGING HIGH-STAKES DILEMMAS FROM MULTIPLE PERSPECTIVES
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (CLASH) specifically for evaluating Large Language Models on moral and ethical dilemmas. It explicitly incorporates various ethical theories such as Deontology, Utilitarianism, and Virtue Ethics to analyze model reasoning, and it includes scenarios involving religious and cultural values, such as Sikh temple construction.
